# Ruslan Drozdov (Руслан Дроздов)

> Personal site of Ruslan Drozdov (Ukrainian: Руслан Дроздов, nickname: drozdorus) — Ukrainian entrepreneur and investor. Founder of Calma, a performance lead generation agency for US insurance, financial, legal, and home services verticals. Partner at the Ukrainian venture fund Adventures Lab.

## Pages

- [Home (English)](https://drozdorus.com/): bio, current roles, portfolio, media
- [Українська версія](https://drozdorus.com/ua/)

## Career facts

- 2014–2018: worked at Everad, an international affiliate network, growing as a manager and marketer
- 2018: founder of Traffinad, a media-buying agency
- 2019–now: partner at Adventures Lab, Ukrainian venture capital fund (https://adventureslab.vc/)
- 2022–2026: partner at Astroid, web3 venture studio (https://astroid.xyz/)
- 2022–2024: venture partner at CLUST, venture builder
- 2024–now: founder of Calma, performance marketing and lead generation agency (https://calma.io/)
